purpose: Form MGT-7A is the annual return form that One Person Companies and Small Companies must file starting from the financial year 2020-2021 onwards.
who: One Person Company and Small Company
when: Not stated in the Rules text
steps: Determine if the company is a One Person Company or a Small Company.
Prepare the annual return for the applicable financial year starting from 2020-2021 onwards.
File the annual return in Form No. MGT-7A.
checklist: Verify that the company is a One Person Company or a Small Company.
Confirm the financial year is 2020-2021 or later.
Check if certification in Form No. MGT.8 by a Company Secretary in practice is required based on paid-up share capital, turnover, or listed status.
watch: Form MGT.8 certification by a Company Secretary in practice is required if the company is a listed company, has a paid-up share capital of ten crore rupees or more, or has a turnover of fifty crore rupees or more.
